name: Salzbergen (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of red, white and red in the proportions 1:3:1, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Salzbergen (three flames and a wavy bar on red and white).
history: The flag of the municipality is red, white and red in the ratio 1:3:1 striped horizontally, charged at the centre with the municipal arms.

features.role: Salzbergen arms — flames and wavy bar
